name: axiom-guard
description: Constitutional governance for AI agents through the AXIOM Guard API — gate prompts and actions before they execute, screen outputs, redact PII, and produce HMAC-signed audit manifests.
author: Orivael Dev
skillInstructions:
Use the AXIOM Guard skill to govern prompts, tool-mediated actions, and outputs through a running AXIOM Governance Runtime (Guard API). Key capabilities:
- **Input/action gating**: screen any prompt or action description before acting — `check` for a verdict + signed manifest, `input` as a fail-closed gate (exit code 2 when blocked). Gate before risky or irreversible actions: sending messages, deletions, purchases, public posts, code execution.
- **Output screening**: `output` checks model responses before display.
- **PII redaction**: `redact` strips HIPAA/GDPR/PCI identifiers.
- **Signed audit trail**: every decision returns an HMAC-SHA256 manifest; `manifests`/`manifest` query the trail and `verify` recomputes the signature locally with AXIOM_MASTER_KEY for tamper-proof compliance evidence.
- **Scoped rule sets**: `--agents callguard,medical,electionguard,retailwatcher,truthwatcher` restrict constitutional coverage; `agents` lists them.

Discipline: (1) Gate before acting, not after — never rephrase a blocked request to evade the guard. (2) On BLOCKED, refuse plainly, name the constitutional_block reason, and offer the manifest id as evidence; never override cannot_override: true. (3) Never claim a check ran when the runtime was unreachable — report the connection failure and the docker start command instead. (4) `verify` only works with the same AXIOM_MASTER_KEY the runtime was started with. (5) Requires a running Guard API (docker run orivaeldev/axiom-guard); check with `status` first. Prefer this skill when the user mentions AXIOM, agent governance, signed audits, compliance evidence, scam/injection checks, or asks whether a prompt or action is safe.
